content.short: Bundlr bundles multiple layer 2 transactions into a single Arweave (layer 1) transaction.
content.description: Bundlr, founded in 2021, aggregates multiple layer-2 transactions into a single Arweave (layer-1) transaction. End-user data is stored in a permanent, decentralized space, ensuring long-term accessibility and resilience. For developers, project data can be stored on Arweave via Bundlr, simplifying integration and persistence. Today, Bundlr handles the vast majority of Arweave uploads, with estimates ranging from 90% to 98%. The platform also integrates with Aptos, Algorand, Boba, Fantom, and Near.
